A '''lab tech''' worked on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], and supplied [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]] with sets for archival. When Pershing had asked to use the information from archives coded for destruction, the lab tech suggested that Pershing could submit a [[C-1023 request]]. The lab tech assured Pershing that his work was truly helping the [[New Republic]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The lab tech appeared in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Lee Isaac Chung]].<ref name="Chapter 19" /> [[Danny Jacobs (The Mandalorian)|Danny Jacobs]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 19" />
